description: This Java source file defines the FilePath class, which provides utility methods for handling file paths, including resolving absolute paths, generating URLs, expanding file path globs, and internal file/directory traversal with logging.

classes.name: FilePath
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for file path resolution, URL creation, glob expansion, and internal file/directory traversal with logging.

classes.name: FilePath.Finder
